messages:
maria_ae: Quick sync — customer (FinX) wants a 4-week POC to validate document summarization and Q&A for 10M doc tokens/month. Need to align on success criteria and capacity.

sam_solutions: ok. Do they have target latency/SLAs for production?

maria_ae: They said user-facing search responses should be < 300ms p95 for single-question flows, but for long multi-turn QA they can accept up to 800ms. Budget: $15k for the POC (all-in).

lee_infra: 10M doc tokens/month -> what's expected concurrency during peak?

maria_ae: They estimated 200 concurrent users at peak, average session ~6 queries, typical prompt + doc context ~1.8k tokens per query.

anita_eng: rough math: 200 concurrent * 1 rps each -> 200 rps, at 1.8k tokens = 360k tokens/s? that seems off. We should split read vs generate.

sam_solutions: yeah, they mean 200 active users but not all hitting at same millisecond. Let's ask for realistic QPS.

maria_ae: Follow-up from customer: expected QPS ~25 peak, sustained ~8. Sorry for confusion.

anita_eng: ok that makes more sense. 25 qps * 1800 tokens = 45k tokens/s. For POC we can use batching, caching, and a smaller context window for most queries.

lee_infra: GPU sizing thought: if we use gpt-like 7B open model (quantized) on 80GB A100 with our runtime, we can sustain ~30 qps with 1 GPU if we tune batching aggressively and warm KV cache. But with 25 qps and headroom, recommend 1 dedicated A100 80GB for the POC. If they want redundancy, add 1 hot-standby.

anita_eng: cost estimate for 4 weeks (POC): A100 80GB reserved node ~ $9/hr (internal list), ~ 24hr/day * 28 days => ~ $6k per GPU. Add infra (load balancer, storage, egress) -> +$1k. Engineering support + eval harness -> $3.5k. Total ~ $10.5k. Leaves room within $15k.

maria_ae: Good. Call out optional cheaper approach: use 2x 40GB GPUs with model sharding? Is that viable?

lee_infra: 2x40GB (e.g., A40) may work but increases complexity and could hurt latency. For a tight POC timeline I prefer single 80GB.

sam_solutions: Success criteria we should propose to customer: 1) p95 latency <= 300ms for single-turn queries on 90% of sampled prompts; 2) semantic accuracy: F1 >= 0.78 on their eval set of 200 prompts; 3) cost per 1k tokens <= $0.03 during POC (in our infra accounting); 4) integration checklist (VPC peering + IP allowlist configured). Agree?

maria_ae: yes. Also they flagged security questionnaire items: SOC2 attestation, KMS integration, audit logs. Security said we can provide SOC2 + KMS options in Private/Dedicated; need to clarify for hosted.

security_bot: security-bot: please complete the standard security QA: link https://redwood.internal/sec-qa. Required fields: data retention, encryption at rest, KMS, audit logs, vendor contacts.

lee_infra: action items: (1) sam to send tech spec + prompts sample to eng (due EOD tomorrow), (2) anita to draft capacity runway + perf tests (48h load test) by Thur, (3) maria to confirm POC start date and sign PO by next Tue.

anita_eng: noted. For perf tests I need a sample of their top 50 prompt templates and distribution of context sizes. If they can't provide, we'll synthetic-issue a 80/15/5 split small/med/large contexts.

sam_solutions: will request sample prompts in the same thread and include token histograms.

maria_ae: Customer asked about fallback plan if we hit capacity: automatic routing to smaller quantized model + degrade to 2x latency but keep availability. Is that supported?

anita_eng: yes, our runtime supports policy-based fallback to a smaller model variant. We'll document expected latency and quality delta.

lee_infra: final note on pricing: if they want dedicated node for POC and then convert to committed Dedicated, we can credit 50% of POC infra fees into the first month of committed billing. Mention in proposal.

maria_ae: perfect. I'll update the SOW with success criteria + cost and send for signature. Ping me if you need anything for the security QA. :thumbsup:
